info.name: Hospital Management API (Day 09)
info.description: Run the folders in order (Runner, or `postman collection run`). Dates are computed from today and every code includes a random run id, so the collection can be run again at any time without resetting the database. Every request has tests.

exec: // Runs before EVERY request. Dates are computed from today, so the collection never goes out of date.
function plus(d, n) { const x = new Date(d); x.setDate(x.getDate() + n); return x; }
// A different number per run: department, doctor and patient codes stay unique,
// so the collection can be run again without resetting the database.
// visitDate = a Monday at least 2 days ahead; the rest are named after their weekday
// Runs after EVERY request: every error response must use the standard error format.
pm.test('error body has timestamp, status, errorCode, message, path', () => {
pm.test('one completed visit with its diagnosis', () => { const h = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(h).to.have.length(1); pm.expect(h[0].diagnosis).to.eql('Tension-type headache'); });
pm.test('our doctor is NOT available', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(d => d.id)).to.not.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get('doctorId'))));
pm.test('field error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().validationErrors.appointmentDate).to.eql('appointmentDate must not be in the past'));
pm.test('field error', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().validationErrors.endTimeAfterStartTime).to.eql('endTime must be after startTime'));

item.name: Complete with follow-up BEFORE the visit -> 422
Audit trail has no COMPLETED row

exec: pm.test('4 appointments in 2 pages of 2', () => { pm.expect(p.totalElements).to.eql(4); pm.expect(p.totalPages).to.eql(2); pm.expect(p.content).to.have.length(2); });

item.name: 7. Day 09: working hours, leave and slots

exec: pm.test('WORKING, 8 slots, all free', () => { pm.expect(r.dayStatus).to.eql('WORKING'); pm.expect(r.slots).to.have.length(8); pm.expect(r.freeSlots).to.eql(8); });
pm.test('says why', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().message).to.include('does not work on SATURDAY'));

item.name: 8. Day 09: audit trail, notifications, NO_SHOW job

exec: pm.test('two rows, oldest first', () => { pm.expect(h.map(c => c.toStatus)).to.eql(['BOOKED','CANCELLED']); pm.expect(h[0].fromStatus).to.be.null; pm.expect(h[1].changedBy).to.eql('API'); });
pm.test('sent to the patient e-mail', () => pm.expect(mine[0].recipient).to.eql('rajiv' + pm.collectionVariables.get('runId') + '@example.com'));
